tests.exercises: Coupled Labrador Sea ocean (20x16x23, 2 deg) with dynamic-thermodynamic sea ice: LSR viscous-plastic solver (LSR_ERROR=1e-4), 7-category thermodynamics (SEAICE_multDim=7), advection scheme 7, exf forcing, 10 steps of 3600 s
tests.why: Deterministic single-process tile loop; the graded window is a few steps of a diffusive, dissipative ice-ocean system, so round-off does not grow: pointwise. Reproduces upstream to 11 digits on cg2d and 13-22 on the ice fields.

tests.exercises: Same domain with free-drift ice dynamics (SEAICEuseFREEDRIFT) and the 3rd-order DST advection of thickness (SEAICEadvSchHeff=33)
tests.why: Deterministic single-process tile loop; the graded window is a few steps of a diffusive, dissipative ice-ocean system, so round-off does not grow: pointwise. Free drift removes the iterative solver, so the floor is set by the thermodynamics alone; 13 digits upstream.

tests.exercises: Hibler-Bryan 1987 style single-category ice (SEAICE_multDim=1, adv scheme 2, ice step equal to the ocean step)
tests.why: Not suitable: reproduces the upstream reference to only 5 digits on cg2d and 4-9 on the ice fields with gfortran, which means this deck amplifies round-off (the centred adv scheme 2 with the old single-category thermodynamics is dispersive); a pointwise floor cannot be established from it.

tests.exercises: Labrador Sea with tight LSR convergence (LSR_ERROR=1e-12) and pkg/salt_plume distributing brine rejection over depth
tests.why: Deterministic single-process tile loop; the graded window is a few steps of a diffusive, dissipative ice-ocean system, so round-off does not grow: pointwise. 16 digits upstream on every monitored field; the tight LSR tolerance makes the dynamics floor round-off level.

tests.why: Deterministic single-process tile loop; the graded window is a few steps of a diffusive, dissipative ice-ocean system, so round-off does not grow: pointwise. 13 digits upstream.

tests.exercises: Labrador Sea with pkg/longstep sub-stepping the passive tracers relative to the sea-ice and momentum steps
tests.why: Deterministic single-process tile loop; the graded window is a few steps of a diffusive, dissipative ice-ocean system, so round-off does not grow: pointwise. 16 digits upstream; exercises ptracer coupling rather than the ice solver, lower priority for this module.

tests.exercises: Idealised 40x21 channel, ocean frozen, 7-category ice thickness distribution (ITD) with linear remapping, LSR solver at LSR_ERROR=1e-12, multidimensional advection 77, 12 steps of 1800 s
tests.why: Deterministic single-process tile loop; the graded window is a few steps of a diffusive, dissipative ice-ocean system, so round-off does not grow: pointwise. The ITD category remapping and ridging are the expensive per-cell thermodynamics; 12 digits upstream.

tests.exercises: ITD channel without linear remapping (SEAICEuseLinRemapITD=.FALSE.) and DST advection 33
tests.why: Not suitable: 7 digits against upstream (6-9 on the ice fields): category thresholds in the non-remapped ITD switch on round-off, so a pointwise floor is not measurable; would need invariants and is dropped in favour of the two remapped decks.
